searchText: Hi all, I had a quick question regarding discv4 and discv5 I am writing my own ~custom node I have implemented discv4 and it works fine I have not implemented (and most probably will not) implement discv5 My issue is that a lot of nodes are trying to connect to my node using discv5, which ultimately fails Is there not a way to advertise (say some enr flag) that my node does not accept discv4? Thanks! Good question. AFAIK there is nothing in the ENR that distinguishes nodes that support discv5 and those that don't. CL clients are on discv5, and some EL clients also support v5. It would be good if we could move EL clients to v5 and eventually drop v4 support. is there a way to track which? as far as I know, Geth support is enabled by default, Nethermind support exists but isn't enabled by default, and of the other non-Nimbus EL ones (it supports both) I don't know We could start with a quick poll here. Then agree on where to go, and track status - Geth default: discv4: on ; discv5: on (use `--discovery.v4` , `--discovery.v5` flags to change) - Nimbus EL: both v4 and v5 supported and enabled by default. Flags are `--discovery=v4`, `--discovery=v5`, and `--discovery=v4,v5` depending on goal Nice thanks both for the clarification! <@741651225576996935> , what about Besu? - Is there discv5 support? - Is it on by default? - Do you share the same discovery codebase with CL? support for discv5 is a WIP https://github.com/hyperledger/besu/issues/4089, and yes the codebase is shared with Teku <@654267572107083777> Is there a "usual place" where we do such trackers? I really want to turn off discv4 by default the only reason we still have it at all in Geth is to support clients which are not running v5 we are now at the point where all major clients have v5 implemented so it would be good to decide the timeline of shutting down v4

excerpts.author: mlettry
excerpts.content:
Hi all, I had a quick question regarding discv4 and discv5

I am writing my own ~custom node

I have implemented discv4 and it works fine

I have not implemented (and  most probably will not) implement discv5

My issue is that a lot of nodes are trying to connect to my node using discv5, which ultimately fails

Is there not a way to advertise (say some enr flag) that my node does not accept discv4?

Thanks!

excerpts.author: cskiraly
excerpts.content: Good question. AFAIK there is nothing in the ENR that distinguishes nodes that support discv5 and those that don't.

excerpts.author: cskiraly
excerpts.content: CL clients are on discv5, and some EL clients also support v5. It would be good if we could move EL clients to v5 and eventually drop v4 support.

excerpts.author: tersec
excerpts.content: is there a way to track which? as far as I know, Geth support is enabled by default, Nethermind support exists but isn't enabled by default, and of the other non-Nimbus EL ones (it supports both) I don't know

excerpts.author: cskiraly
excerpts.content:
We could start with a quick poll here. Then agree on where to go, and track status
- Geth default: discv4: on ; discv5: on (use `--discovery.v4` , `--discovery.v5` flags to change)

excerpts.author: tersec
excerpts.content: - Nimbus EL: both v4 and v5 supported and enabled by default. Flags are `--discovery=v4`, `--discovery=v5`, and `--discovery=v4,v5` depending on goal

excerpts.author: mlettry
excerpts.content: Nice thanks both for the clarification!

excerpts.author: cskiraly
excerpts.content:
<@741651225576996935> , what about Besu?
- Is there discv5 support?
- Is it on by default?
- Do you share the same discovery codebase with CL?

excerpts.author: fab_10
excerpts.content: support for discv5 is a WIP https://github.com/hyperledger/besu/issues/4089, and yes the codebase is shared with Teku

excerpts.author: cskiraly
excerpts.content: <@654267572107083777> Is there a "usual place" where we do such trackers?

excerpts.content: I really want to turn off discv4 by default

excerpts.content: the only reason we still have it at all in Geth is to support clients which are not running v5
